controls.title: ICT Risk Management Framework
controls.desc: Financial entities shall have in place an internal governance and control framework that ensures effective and prudent management of ICT risk.

controls.title: Management Body Responsibility for ICT Risk
controls.desc: The management body shall bear ultimate responsibility for managing the financial entity's ICT risk and shall set clear roles and responsibilities for ICT-related functions.

controls.title: Management Body ICT Training
controls.desc: Members of the management body shall maintain sufficient knowledge and skills to understand and assess ICT risk and its impact on operations.

controls.title: Sound, Comprehensive and Well-Documented ICT Risk Management Framework
controls.desc: Financial entities shall have a sound, comprehensive and well-documented ICT risk management framework as part of their overall risk management system.

controls.title: ICT Risk Management Framework Strategies and Policies
controls.desc: The ICT risk management framework shall include strategies, policies, procedures, ICT protocols and tools necessary to protect ICT assets and infrastructure.

controls.title: ICT Risk Management Framework Review
controls.desc: Financial entities shall review their ICT risk management framework documentation at least once a year or upon major ICT-related incidents.

controls.title: Digital Operational Resilience Strategy
controls.desc: Financial entities shall define and implement a digital operational resilience strategy as an integral component of the ICT risk management framework.

controls.title: ICT Systems, Protocols and Tools Requirements
controls.desc: Financial entities shall use and maintain updated ICT systems, protocols and tools that are appropriate to the scale and complexity of operations.

controls.title: Identification of ICT-Supported Business Functions and Assets
controls.desc: Financial entities shall identify, classify and adequately document all ICT-supported business functions, roles and responsibilities, information assets and ICT assets.

controls.title: ICT Risk Assessment and Documentation
controls.desc: Financial entities shall identify all sources of ICT risk, assess cyber threats and ICT vulnerabilities, and review risk scenarios regularly.

controls.title: ICT Security Protection and Prevention Policies
controls.desc: Financial entities shall use ICT security tools, policies and procedures to protect all information assets and ICT assets.

controls.title: ICT Security Mechanisms and Controls
controls.desc: Financial entities shall design and implement ICT security policies, procedures and controls covering authentication, access control, encryption, and network security.

controls.title: ICT Change Management Procedures
controls.desc: Financial entities shall implement sound ICT change management procedures for all changes to ICT systems including patches, updates and configuration changes.

controls.title: ICT Anomaly Detection and Response
controls.desc: Financial entities shall establish mechanisms to promptly detect anomalous activities including ICT network performance issues and ICT-related incidents.

controls.title: Multi-Layer Detection Controls
controls.desc: Financial entities shall implement detection controls enabling multiple layers of control with defined alert thresholds and criteria for incident response.

controls.title: ICT Business Continuity Policy
controls.desc: Financial entities shall put in place a comprehensive ICT business continuity policy as an integral part of the overall business continuity policy.

controls.title: Business Impact Analysis of ICT Disruptions
controls.desc: Financial entities shall conduct a business impact analysis of their exposure to severe business disruptions considering ICT risk.

controls.title: ICT Business Continuity Plans
controls.desc: Financial entities shall implement ICT business continuity plans that cover all critical functions, are tested regularly, and are updated based on testing outcomes.

controls.title: ICT Disaster Recovery Plans
controls.desc: Financial entities shall establish ICT response and recovery plans subject to independent audit reviews.

controls.title: Crisis Communication Plans
controls.desc: Financial entities shall put in place crisis communication plans enabling responsible disclosure of major ICT-related incidents to stakeholders.

controls.title: Backup Policies and Procedures
controls.desc: Financial entities shall establish backup policies specifying scope, frequency, and methods for backing up data and ICT systems.

controls.title: Backup System Separation
controls.desc: Backup systems shall be physically and logically segregated from the source system to prevent compromise in case of attacks.

controls.title: ICT Lessons Learned and Post-Incident Reviews
controls.desc: Financial entities shall develop capabilities and staffing to gather information on vulnerabilities, threats, and ICT-related incidents, and conduct post-incident reviews.

controls.title: ICT Security Awareness and Training
controls.desc: Financial entities shall develop ICT security awareness programmes and digital operational resilience training as part of compulsory training for all staff.

controls.title: ICT Risk Management for Simplified Framework
controls.desc: Financial entities that qualify as microenterprises or are subject to the simplified ICT risk management framework shall establish and maintain a sound and documented ICT risk management framework pro

controls.title: Risk Mitigation
controls.desc: Risks shall be mitigated to an acceptable level.
